Overview
Welcome to The Veritas Search. We have hidden 11 capsules across campus, each granting a special reward to the student who finds it. Winners get unique rewards, including a limousine ride to Harvard–Yale, a personal meeting with former Red Sox GM Theo Epstein, and free daily Olmo bagels, among others. All winners will be invited to a commencement ceremony where the order of prize selection will be determined by a weighted lottery. Higher placements receive better odds, but every winner has a chance to pick first.
